answers.rationale: This requirement pertains to lighting and receptacles, which are not covered by the listed products in the catalog. The bid manager should address this.

The requirement specifies current transformers and terminal blocks for feeder breaker cubicles, which align with the features of CROWN-ARMV metal-clad switchgear, including CTs and VTs for relaying and metering.
Voltage transformers for metering on the main bus are typically part of the metal-clad switchgear lineup, which matches the CROWN-ARMV product description.
Thermostatically controlled heaters and LED lamps in control cubicles are features of metal-clad switchgear cubicles, aligning with the CROWN-ARMV product.
The AC and DC voltage distribution panelboard described matches the auxiliary power system (AC/DC) provided by EP2-AUX, which includes AC/DC panels and distribution systems.
